findings.evidence: User name is stored locally in SharedPreferences using key 'user_name' in AppPreferences.kt (lines 11, 31, 36) and is used exclusively on-device for UI personalization in HomeDashboard, ProfileSetupScreen, and SettingsScreen.
findings.recommendation: Ensure the Google Play Data Safety form reflects that user name data is processed strictly locally and not collected or transmitted off-device.

findings.evidence: Search match 'race' was a false positive resulting from 'e.printStackTrace()' exception logging calls in BootReceiver, NotificationActionReceiver, and NotificationReceiver. No race or ethnicity data is collected, processed, or transmitted.
findings.recommendation: No action required. Race or ethnicity data is neither collected nor transmitted by the application.

findings.recommendation: No action required. Music files are neither accessed nor collected by the application.

findings.evidence: PowerManager.isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations is queried strictly on-device to check system battery optimization settings for reliable alarm scheduling; data is not transmitted off-device.
findings.recommendation: No action required as performance and battery diagnostics are not collected or transmitted off-device.

findings.evidence: RingtoneManager.getDefaultUri is used strictly on-device to fetch default system alarm ringtone URI for notification channels; audio data is not recorded, stored, or transmitted off-device.
findings.recommendation: No action required as audio files and settings remain local to the device for notification alerts.

findings.issue_summary: The app requests the restricted 'android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM' permission in AndroidManifest.xml, but as a productivity task and routine planner, it does not qualify for this permission under Google Play policy.
findings.evidence: app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml line 6 declares <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM" /> alongside SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM. The app is a task/routine planner (com.dalgeer.lifeplanner) using exact alarms for task and routine reminders in AlarmScheduler.kt.
findings.recommendation: Remove <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM" /> from app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml. Rely instead on android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM with runtime checks using PermissionUtils.canScheduleExactAlarms().
